title: Synergistic, theoretical, and experimental study of the interaction of a tri-heterometallic polymer with bovine liver catalase
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27033-27045
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02826D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Narges Lashkarzade, Fereshteh Shiri, Somaye Shahraki, Zohreh Razmara, Mostafa Heidari Majd
This study presents a tri-heterometallic Cu/Mn/Na polymer as a redox-modulating agent with enhanced catalase activity, mechanistic interaction with antioxidant pathways, and selective antiproliferative effects against colon cancer cells.
